citeinfo.title: Daily operating standard data used for verification of the Petroleum Geochemistry Research Laboratory Method for Qualitative Biomarker Analysis of Crude Oil and Rock Extracts by Gas Chromatography-Single Quadrupole Mass Spectrometry

Petroleum Geochemistry Research Laboratory Method for Qualitative Biomarker Analysis of Crude Oil and Rock Extracts by Gas Chromatography-Single Quadrupole Mass Spectrometry https://doi.org/10.5066/P9V47O5W

descript.abstract: The data release contains biomarker data generated by Gas Chromatography-Single Quadrupole Mass Spectrometry in the Petroleum Geochemistry Research Laboratory. The data was used to determine the precision and accuracy of one daily operating standard for the method entitled, “Petroleum Geochemistry Research Laboratory Method for Qualitative Biomarker Analysis of Crude Oil and Rock Extracts by Gas Chromatography-Single Quadrupole Mass Spectrometry”.
descript.purpose: These data were generated on one daily operating standard to verify that the Petroleum Geochemistry Research Laboratory Method for Qualitative Biomarker Analysis of Crude Oil and Rock Extracts by Gas Chromatography-Single Quadrupole Mass Spectrometry provides data that are consistent with those previously reported for the same standard by the Norwegian Petroleum Directorate. (Weiss et al., 2000). The results are for internal laboratory standards used for quality control purposes.

procstep.procdesc: The saturated and aromatic hydrocarbon fractions were isolated from the deasphaltened fraction known as the maltene fraction by chromatographic column separation using a mixed silica-alumina solid phase and successive elution with iso-octane and benzene, respectively. The saturated and aromatic fractions were separately analyzed by an Agilent 8890 Gas Chromatograph (GC) coupled to an Agilent 5977B Mass Selective Detector (MSD). The acquisition and data processing were completed using Agilent OpenLab CDS v. 2.5 software.
